t: Music platforms where you can actually buy and download your music | ResetEra
s: April 28, 2023 - bandcamp is great for artists that range from 'person noodling in their bedroom' up to about 'low-to-middle billing on coachella', but you aren't going to find many mainstream popular artists - whether current or legacy - on there. it is still something to keep in mind because, as far as i am aware, it is still the largest storefront that gives the highest share to the artist. there is some union busting garbage going on after the epic games purchase of the site that puts a sour taste in my mouth, but for now i think it is the best of imperfect options where applicable. for music that isn't there, while i haven't bought anything from apple's store in many years, you certainly could buy from it in the past & put those songs on non-apple devices.
